metadata.name: NVIDIA App
metadata.description: Local MCP server built into the NVIDIA App for Windows (11.0.9.5xx and later): driver status and release notes, installed games and applications, per-game optimization, laptop features, and In-Game Overlay recording, Instant Replay and Highlights. Listens on loopback only.

config.notes: Requires NVIDIA App 11.0.9.5xx or later with 'Allow AI agents to control NVIDIA App' enabled under Settings > Features. 13508 is the default port; if it is taken the server falls back to 13509-13518 and then 49152-49161, and the active URL is in %LOCALAPPDATA%\NVIDIA Corporation\NvAppMcpServer\server.json.
